column1: # Claude's own judgement of web photos (Flickr CC BY, sets Claude called Indian by eye), read set by set in order.

column6: words
the groom lifts the heavy jasmine garland over the bride's head, elders watching: the garlanding itself
the couple in their garlands, hands folded in prayer, family close behind: both faces right after the garlanding
the couple seated on the floor signing the marriage register, an elder guiding them
an elder lady gives the bride milk from a cup: the first turn of the milk-and-sweet custom after the wedding
a young woman in blue gives the groom his sip, smiling: another close relative's turn, a clear frame
the same woman now feeding the bride: repeats her turn
a man offers the cup, the bride looks away at the camera: another turn, weaker
the elder lady in pink feeding the bride again: same person as before
another lady's turn with the groom: repeats the idea
the elder lady feeding the groom: repeats
the couple with the family standing on the stage, full length: the group photo
two relatives sitting by the water away from the function: not part of the day
the bride in her wedding saree on a swing, the groom pushing: a playful once-only picture
the bride in red with her family in the hall, everyone looking at the camera
the bride with elders in suits and sarees: another side of the family
a woman seeking the elders' blessing with betel leaves, but the frame is washed out
the same blessing, clear: she bows to the elders, a child in front
the blessing again with a man's back blocking the view
the ladies in silk sarees lined up before leaving for the hall
the baraat: the groom's party in red turbans dancing, a child on shoulders; heads and a camera in the way but the only frame of it
the couple seated under the mandap, the priest joining their hands (hasta melap), parents beside them; guests' parasols in front
the couple walking round the fire (pheras), tied together: the heart of the wedding
the couple exchanging rings under the mandap
the groom in a cream and red sherwani, full length, flash against a wall: his portrait
the bride in a red lehenga with mehndi, seated, looking aside: her portrait
the bride posing to show her mehndi and bangles: a second, different pose
a lady garlands an elder man while a girl smiles between them: the families' welcome
everyone in a circle dancing to the dhol players, seen from above: the dance at its fullest
a Sikh man in a turban and waistcoat dancing alone on the lawn
two women in pink dancing, one veiled: the ladies' dance
the groom with his friends in kurtas and stoles lined up at home before the wedding: his side's group
the groom in a cream kurta holding his turban, full length in the doorway: his portrait before leaving
the groom between his mother and father at home: the parents' photo
an elder lady circles a lamp over the seated groom while the family watches: the blessing before he leaves
a lady in silk puts a tilak on the seated groom's forehead: another blessing, his face clear
the groom sitting and waiting, men standing around: nothing is happening
the couple in garlands standing under the flower mandap with the priest: the wedding itself, both faces
the priest ties the couple together while guests crowd round; heads in front but the rite is clear
the couple with a lady in a yellow salwar, close up: one relative's photo with them
a family with children beside the couple under the flower canopy, full length
friends from abroad in Indian clothes standing with the couple
another pair of friends with the couple: different people, one photo each
both sets of parents with the newly-weds: the group that must be there
a visiting couple with the newly-weds on the stage
another visiting couple with them: different people
a guest posing alone in a saree in the hall: not about the couple
the couple at the second reception, he in a suit, she in a pale saree, between two elder men: a new day and look
two guests in kurtas talking outdoors: a snapshot of guests
two women guests in sarees laughing in the sun, the decorated roof behind: a happy candid
an elder woman scatters petals on the pond from a steel plate: a quiet preparation, once only
the couple in garlands facing each other, hands joined, both smiling: the wedding moment
the ritual things laid out: bowls of grains, flowers and powders by the fire pit
the whole group of friends in Indian clothes outside the pavilion: the big group photo
four friends dressed up on the steps: a smaller group
books and an ashtray on a table at night: nothing to do with the wedding
two guests standing with a drink at night
a selfie of two guests
two guests in kurtas with drinks
the groom in a suit lifted on shoulders, arm in the air, laughing: the party's high point begins
the bride lifted too, but blurred and cut: the next frame is better
bride and groom both on shoulders holding hands, everyone laughing: the best frame of the lift
the couple dancing at night, the bride laughing in her white lehenga
three guests' selfie
the couple seated on the floor in garlands, the groom's mother bending to the bride, family around: her new family's welcome
women and a girl floating flowers on the pond before the wedding: a gentle preparation
the girl alone reaching for the flowers: the same idea, misty
guests crowding at the doorway with their backs to the camera
the groom in a white kurta and a red-and-white garland, barefoot, smiling: his portrait
the priests with the microphone, only the edge of the groom's crown: the couple hardly seen
the priest reaching to the groom, seen from behind him: cluttered, the next frames are better
the same frame again
close on the priest and the bride in her crown looking at the groom: her face in the rite
the couple seated side by side in topor and crown with garlands, the bride smiling down: the picture of this wedding
the priest chanting, the couple and a bridesmaid in orange at the offerings
the couple standing at the fire, his hands round hers for the offering, full length
five ladies in Bengali sarees together on the lawn: the aunts' photo
a band on stage at the evening party, blurred
three women of the family smiling close together
a family lined up between the two wedding thrones, full length
the mandap on the stage dressed in white flowers, before the ceremony
the groom with the pandit in a dim hall, small and dark
the groom lifted on friends' shoulders in the car park, arms up: his arrival
the groom seated making an offering, the family leaning in: the ceremony up close
the bride in red seen between backs: blocked
the couple in garlands with the parents under the mandap
the bride with her friends in bright sarees, the groom among them
the groom's family, elders in suits, standing together
the couple dancing at the reception, she in a white and red lehenga, laughing
a bronze Ganesh with flowers: the blessing at the entrance
a hand on red sequinned cloth: too close to mean anything
the mandap seen from the back of the hall with the couple and priest under it: the whole scene
two women guests laughing
the same two posing again
the car window painted with wedding bells and the couple's names: just married
a guest couple at a table in the dark
three women at a table, one with eyes closed
the same three again: guests at their table
a woman hugging a little girl in red, both beaming: a warm one
candle-lit tables in the dark: mood only, nothing to see
the bride in gold between two friends at night, all smiling at the camera
a guest in a long kurta posing by a window
two women laughing close up in bright silk and gold: joy in the crowd
women dancing in a crowd, an arm with bangles raised: the ladies' celebration
the groom in a turban riding in a decorated carriage under a red parasol: his arrival
a woman in red with a little girl in a cream shawl, both smiling in the sun
the groom's procession dancing in the car park, red turbans everywhere, seen wide
women dancing beside the dhol player in the procession
the dhol and the dancers again: repeats
the groom in a white sherwani dancing with a woman in pink, the crowd in a ring round them: his own dance
three women seen from behind: backs only
the stick dance in the hall at night, sticks raised
the groom seen between two women from behind: blocked
the bride laughing under a yellow cloth held over her: the turmeric evening
women and a baby crowding in and laughing, one holding the yellow cloth
the groom smeared with turmeric, laughing, holding out his yellow palms: the haldi at its funniest
a small boy grinning at the camera: one of the children
two women smiling, one showing her mehndi-covered palm
a woman in red smiling in the dark: a clear portrait of one of the family
elders holding a plate of lamps together: the family's blessing
another relative with the lamp plate, the bride's back to us: repeats
a man circles the lamps before the bride, her face lit by them: the blessing with her in it
a guest trying on an outfit in a bedroom
two women at the door under the garland: a pair of relatives
the groom in a grey suit and the bride in red and gold with her wedding bangles, laughing as she straightens his tie: the couple's portrait
the couple hugging outdoors against the sky, he in sunglasses: a second, candid one
a young man's face very close: a guest
the dhol player and the singer on the stage: the music of the day
a man's profile close up in the sun
two visiting guests in kurtas in the garden
a guest in sunglasses smiling
a guest with a camera in the garden
